clues.clue: Bed covers medium for cosiness
Side of duck prepared for gourmets
Pine endlessly for attention
Healing cure that I merged with PE
Is trying on nail polish an unpleasant feeling?
Inane writer’s rancour about City
Lovely guess
One in a shower cap coating one in a lather
Luther’s the cause one’s left abandoned
Selfish person’s party spirit, other people temper
Making your mark, opening with underwear half-removed
Fish being skinless helped
Aunt Maud’s regularly drunk and falls
Gathering in street after race victor enters
Fresh sandwiches are transformed by soft cheese
School examiner?
Roman port of old with islands to the north
Sample clothes newly lined in the latest style
Trousers and blazers used in emergencies
Shots of batsmen after stripping off extra gear
At the front with gunners vulnerable to attack
Bag with zip, not a hit
Risk period stimulated net gain
Bad press about crime, mostly it is made up
Excited as always tucking into salmon?
Delays unlikely aboard ship
A cycling expert’s promise
Passionate backing singer

competition.prizeinfo: A collection of Times reference books — The Times  Reference  Atlas, Collins English Dictionary & Thesaurus, and Bradford’s Crossword Solver’s Dictionary, published by HarperCollins —  will be awarded for the first randomly selected correct solution. The Collins English Dictionary & Thesaurus will be awarded for the next three. To enter, complete the crossword and submit your entry. 18+ only. Closing date is 23:59 on the first Saturday after publication. Full T&Cs apply. Printed entries can be sent to: The Sunday Times Crossword 5234, PO Box 29, Colchester, Essex CO2 8GZ.
